exposure: hemodynamic changes of fetal vessels (umbilical artery, middle cerebral artery, aortic arch isthmus)

color Doppler ultrasound (CDUS) indicators (arterial resistance index (RI), blood flow pulsatility index (PI), systolic and diastolic velocity (S/D), peak systolic velocity (PSV)/end-systolic reflux velocity (ESRV))
cohort: The study included 150 pregnant women who received prenatal examination between January 2021 and August 2023, divided into 75 with fetuses diagnosed with FGR and 75 with healthy fetuses.
finding: Fetal umbilical artery, middle cerebral artery, and aortic arch isthmus parameters detected through CDUS are sensitive indices for assessing FGR.
cross-section timing: During prenatal examination when fetuses were diagnosed with FGR or confirmed healthy.
